bazar-dor.tagline: Everyday market prices, all in one place.
bazar-dor.overview: BazarDor is a full-stack web application designed to make everyday market prices in Bangladesh easier to explore and compare. Built with Next.js, it brings essential commodity information into a single interface and explores how authentication, database integration, and market-price data can work together to create a useful everyday tool.
features: View price changes and market trends
Responsive interface for different screen sizes
challenges: Integrating Better Auth with Next.js and MongoDB required understanding authentication flows and database configuration.
Configuring Google and GitHub OAuth across local development and production environments required careful debugging.
Organizing market-price information into clear, reusable, and responsive interfaces required attention to data presentation and usability.
improvements: Expand historical price tracking and trend visualization.
Improve data validation and API error handling.
Enhance market comparison with more detailed insights.

fit-log.tagline: A smarter way to explore and organize workouts.
fit-log.overview: FitLog is a responsive workout discovery and planning application built with Next.js and TypeScript. The project focuses on presenting exercise information in a clean, organized interface while allowing users to build a personal workout plan. It combines reusable UI components, dynamic workout details, and plan management to create a more structured workout-planning experience.
features: Browse a library of workout exercises
Explore exercises by muscle group and equipment
Track planned workout duration and estimated calories
challenges: Integrating external workout API data into reusable components required careful data handling.
Managing saved exercises and planned workouts required consistent state management and duplicate prevention.
Building a responsive interface that closely follows the intended design required attention to spacing, typography, and layout.
improvements: Add persistent workout plans across sessions.
Introduce workout history and progress tracking.

dev-stack.tagline: Discover the right tools for your next development project.
dev-stack.overview: DevStack is a web development project focused on presenting development technologies and tools through an organized, user-friendly interface. Built with React and modern styling tools, the project explores reusable components, structured technology data, and responsive layouts to make browsing development resources more intuitive.
features: Organize technology information into reusable data structures
Responsive layouts for desktop and mobile
challenges: Structuring technology information in a maintainable format required careful component and data organization.
Creating reusable sections helped reduce duplication while keeping the interface consistent.
Matching the intended design across different screen sizes required iterative layout and styling adjustments.
improvements: Add technology search and category filtering.
Provide more detailed information for individual technologies.
Expand the collection of development tools and resources.
